content: Namo guru mañjughoṣāya!I prostrate to the Victors and their heirs.May all sentient beings in the realms be happy.I shall compose a poetic ornament of the Victors' heirs,A feast of Dharma from the scriptures of the Victors.May all the multitudes of wandering beings, without exception,With a powerful, sincere, and earnest motivation,And with the vast wisdom of a discerning intellect,Purify the filth of the negative karma and obscurations.If one does not purify negative karma and obscurations quickly, quickly,Because this karma of ours is so powerful,Even if one knows what is happy, one has no power to attain it;Even if one knows what is painful, one has no power to cast it off.Most ordinary beings are tormented by their karma.Even the noble Śrāvakas, the "small-bent" ones and others,And some of the Victors' own disciples,Are said to be tormented by the truth of the fruits of karma.Is this karma produced or not produced by various joys and sorrows?Do the Sugatas of the three times know it or not know it?Do immeasurable sentient beings experience it or not experience it?Is it never separated from oneself, even though one has nowhere to go?Therefore, thinking that the fruits of karma are infallible,Now, make your choice regarding white and black actions.From this day forward, resolve to shun wrongdoing;From this night forward, strive to engage in virtue.Whether actions are white or black depends on whether the intention is good or bad.If the intention is good, the grounds and paths will also be good;If the intention is inferior, the grounds and paths will also be inferior.Since everything depends upon the intention,Holding onto evil thoughts of wanting to compete with equals,And being pulled by partiality, attachment, and aversion—Are these not the very causes of one's own suffering?Think well on this again and again, you who are wise.The deceiver of the path of non-virtuous action,The fickle, childish mind of desire and craving—When it leads the mind astray, suffering arises;Look at the way Devadatta was consumed by attachment and aversion.Therefore, generate and cultivate a good-hearted mind.If this mind is virtuous, this life of leisure and opportunity is meaningful;If this mind is non-virtuous, this life of leisure and opportunity is meaningless.Make this mind virtuous, all you friends.Remaining in a virtuous state of mind, the meaning of the scriptures,First, resolve your misconceptions through hearing and reflection.Thereafter, while maintaining that resolution from hearing and reflection,Go to a secluded place and meditate; that is truly meaningful.Following that, generate a mind solely dedicated to the benefit of others,Thinking of all sentient beings without exception as your fathers and mothers,And mindful of the kindness they have shown you in countless ways,Do whatever you can to be of benefit, and bring benefit to all.Recognizing what has been done for you and repaying that kindness—This is excellent for oneself and others, in this life and the next.Those who repay such kindness with malice,Are said to be lower even than animals.For the beings of this degenerate age,Possess a mind of altruism that loves them as a mother loves her child;Teach the holy Dharma to all sentient beings,And train in the footsteps of the Teacher, the Buddha.This mind that benefits others through faith is excellent;This excellence is more faithful than a mind that merely seeks to benefit.When taught through reasoning, it benefits the mind when needed;When the mind is intent on benefit, it is fitting to teach as needed.Train in a good heart, and the intention to harm will gradually diminish.Meditate on meditative absorption, and the two obscurations will naturally fade.Generate compassion, and virtue will increase of its own accord.Rely on the antidote, and mental afflictions will dissolve where they arise.Enemies may act as friends, and friends may act as enemies.Who can say who will harbor malice, or toward whom it will be directed?If you reflect, you will see that all are kinsmen and parents.In short, abandon the mind of sin and rely on the mind of virtue.Do not harbor malice in your mind; hold fast to the intention to benefit.Contemplate the meaning of what you have heard, and tame your mind through meditation.Abandon the pointless affairs of the world and rely on what is meaningful.If, by any means, you cannot abandon the world,It is a matter of how you carry your thoughts—as Dharma or non-Dharma.There are methods to transform the bustle and noise into the path of Dharma.Offer yourself heartfelt advice,Saying that the fruit of white is white, and the fruit of black is black.It is said that the fruit of benefit is happiness, and the fruit of harm is suffering.Treat friends and companions as you would your own parents.If you benefit others even slightly, you benefit yourself.This intention to harm, which burns the thicket of others' happiness—It is a vessel for accumulating the filth of non-virtue and obscurations.Abandon from afar the accumulation of pointless non-virtue and obscurations.Generate devotion toward all objects of the Dharma.Meditate on loving-kindness toward all sentient beings.Think expansively, saying, "May all I see become happy."Investigate and analyze the Dharma that generates joyful enthusiasm.When this Dharma enters the mind of one who has faith,And you contemplate it thus, the feast of the Dharma is revealed.This root text is composed in easy-to-understand verse.The commentary exists solely in the lineage of the realized teachings.Look at the words, and there is the spectacle of composition.Look at the meaning, and there is the way to practice the holy Dharma.I have condensed all the sublime scriptural systems into a few words.I wrote these lines so that people might look upon them.Generate the certainty of conviction, and it will grow ever greater.May those with intelligence contemplate this and grasp the meaning.Some compose knots of pointless words.Others speak nonsense, foolish words without connection.The author who composes with elegant structure and clarityIs, here in the Land of Snows, Blo-bzang-grags-pa'i-dpal.Beautified by the flickering garlands of a helpful mind,From the gathering of rain clouds of virtuous intention,A rain of precious, perfect happiness descends,May all beings enjoy the splendor of joy and well-being.May I and all infinite beings without exception,Make firm the accomplishments of the yidam's speech,And may we obtain all immeasurable benefit and happiness,Together with the supreme accomplishment of ultimate reality.
